name: generate_video
description: Generate AI videos with xAI Grok or Google Gemini. Create videos from text prompts or images. Use when user says 'generate a video', 'create a video', 'make a video animation', 'animate this'. PROVIDERS: xAI Grok (default, 1-15s) and Google Gemini (Veo default: 4-8s and up to 4K; Omni Flash opt-in: 3-10s and 720p). Videos save to stash for use with other tools. Optional HeyGen Video 1 is available only when HEYGEN_API_KEY is configured; text/image clips with audio, 5-15s. Scripted talking avatars use the separate HeyGen avatar tool.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the video. Be specific about subject, action, movement, style, mood. For audio: Use quotes for dialogue like 'Hello!' and describe sounds. Example: 'A cat playing with a ball, slow motion, cinematic lighting'

provider.description: Video provider: 'xai' (default, Grok - 1-15s) or 'gemini' (Veo 3.1 by default; Omni Flash when configured). If not specified, uses VIDEO_TOOL_PROVIDER from config. Optional heygen uses HeyGen Video 1 and requires HEYGEN_API_KEY.

model.description: Explicit provider-specific video model. Only set when the user requests a particular model; otherwise omit it to use the Jarvis Web override, provider ENV pin, or catalog default.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. xAI: 1-15s (any). Gemini Veo: rounds to 4, 6, or 8s. Gemini Omni Flash: clamps to 3-10s. Default: 5 seconds. HeyGen: 5-15s.

aspect_ratio.description: Video shape. xAI: 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3. Gemini supports '16:9' (widescreen) or '9:16' (vertical); other values are mapped. HeyGen supports 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, and 21:9.

resolution.description: Video resolution. xAI: 720p/480p. Gemini Veo: 720p-4k (1080p/4k requires 8s). Gemini Omni Flash: 720p only. HeyGen: 480p/768p/1080p/2k; legacy 720p maps to 768p and the result reports actual resolution.

image_url.description: Image source for image-to-video. Accepts: stash reference (stash://space_xxx/file_id), local file path, or URL. For uploaded images, use the stash reference from 'Image stashed at:' in the conversation.

video_url.description: Edit an existing video's visual content/style ONLY. xAI editing CANNOT change duration, aspect ratio, or resolution — only what happens visually. If user wants different duration/size, regenerate from source image using image_url instead. xAI requires a public http(s) URL; stash refs will not work. Provider URLs expire after about 4 hours.

negative_prompt.description: GEMINI ONLY: What to avoid in the video. Sent as Veo's negative prompt or appended as regular prompt guidance for Omni Flash.

save.description: Save to stash for use with other tools (default: true). Video is downloaded and stored locally.

availability.setup_hint: Configure at least one video provider API key (GEMINI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, or optional HEYGEN_API_KEY) in the active mode env file.
